framework: HIPAA Security Rule and Breach Notification Rule
source: Citations and titles from 45 CFR Parts 160 and 164, Subparts C and D. Guidance wording is original to Offset Security; it is not the text of the regulation, and it is not legal advice.
disclaimer: Offset Abide is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or certified by the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services. HIPAA has no certification: no product can make you compliant, and no auditor can certify you.

kpis.inPlaceTip: Requirements that apply and are in place.
kpis.withEvidenceTip: Requirements in place that have something attached to prove them.

scope.title: Scope: where ePHI is
scope.detail: Which systems, places and people create, receive, keep or send ePHI.

method.title: Risk analysis method
method.detail: How risks to ePHI are found, scored and accepted, and who decides.

soa.title: Required and addressable decisions
soa.detail: Every requirement, whether it applies, and for each addressable one the decision and its reason.

controls.title: Safeguards in place
controls.detail: The administrative, physical and technical safeguards in scope, and how many are in place.

evidence.detail: Evidence kept with its date and who owns it. Keep it for six years.

gaps.title: Requirements with nothing to prove them
gaps.detail: Requirements marked in place that have nothing attached to prove it.

findings.detail: Findings raised, and what closed each one.

suppliers.title: Business associates
suppliers.detail: Who handles ePHI for you, and the agreement each one signed.

internal.title: Evaluation
internal.detail: A periodic check that your safeguards still meet the Security Rule.

review.title: Documentation review
review.detail: Policies and procedures reviewed, and updated when something changed.
